bounded_host_request.command: set -eu; N=$(git worktree list --porcelain | grep -Fc 'branch refs/heads/feat/assistant-ai-and-sales-core' || true); test "$N" -eq 1 || { echo FEATURE_WORKTREE_NOT_UNIQUE; exit 72; }; P=$(git worktree list --porcelain | awk '/^worktree / {p=substr($0,10)} /^branch refs\/heads\/feat\/assistant-ai-and-sales-core$/ {print p}'); test -n "$P"; test -d "$P"; test "$(git -C "$P" branch --show-current)" = feat/assistant-ai-and-sales-core; test -z "$(git -C "$P" status --porcelain --untracked-files=all)" || exit 76; printf 'EXISTING_FEATURE_WORKTREE_CLEAN=YES\n'
